modes.name: unsupported_policy_claim
modes.definition: The reply asserts a policy fact that no retrieved or existing policy doc supports (invented remedies, wrong-store terms, superseded platform defaults).

modes.name: unconfirmed_write_action
modes.definition: The agent executes a write tool (refund, cancel) without explicit user confirmation when the user's message was a question or ambiguous.
modes.requirement_source: SPEC.md revision motivated by annotation T1

modes.name: tool_result_misreport
modes.definition: The reply contradicts or invents what a tool actually returned (pending reported as done, empty results described as data).

modes.name: missing_order_disambiguation
modes.definition: Multiple candidate orders exist and the agent picks one silently instead of asking.
modes.requirement_source: SPEC.md revision motivated by annotation D4

modes.name: stale_context_carryover
modes.definition: A constraint stated earlier in the session is dropped or contradicted later.
modes.requirement_source: SPEC.md revision motivated by annotation D5

modes.name: sycophantic_opener
modes.definition: The reply opens with performative empathy unrelated to the user's actual tone or issue.
